title: API keys
description: Integrations use an API key to act as you on this server, limited to the permissions you choose. A key is shown only once, when it is created or regenerated.
all: All permissions — includes permissions added later
reveal: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.
regenerateWarning: The old key stops working immediately. Update every integration using it.
deleteWarning: This key stops working immediately. Integrations using it will lose access.
readOnlyHelp: Create a key here, switch the integration, then remove the old server entry.
